reviews.title: Used to Have Great Customer Service
reviews.text:
Gametime used to be great. Decent deals and a smooth interface were huge pluses. Their customer support has unfortunately taken a nosedive. They used to do their customer support in house and were extremely helpful the one time I had an issue, even calling and staying on the phone with me until I got into the venue. 

Today I had another issue but sadly this time I got an AI chatbot followed by chat agents that did not speak English well. When I called I was connected to a call center in the Philippines. They placed me on hold and then hung up. 

Sad how much this platform has declined.

reviews.title: Ridiculous prices
reviews.text: I would never buy tickets through this app again. The price i paid for tickets here would have put me in VIP if i bout ticket in other apps. It’s not worth it, just go to ticket master or stub hub. I used this all twice and both times sucked hundreds of extra dollars out for seats that weren’t even worth half of what i paid

reviews.title: Absolute worst app ,
reviews.text: Worst app to but tickets , don’t expect a refund or helpful service. Expect a “ we will look into it “ to never get a response back. Customer service and timely ticket delivery was an issue.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: I reserved tickets and put in my bank account information  and then they “awarded the tickets ti me” then they canceled it right after

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text: Never received tickets or help from any of the several customer service reps. Was told to contact Ticketmaster, I did. No luck. Was told to contact AXS, I did, no luck! Was told to wait 5 days for refund, I did, then they went back on their word and would not refund. Instead told me to drive 4 hours to the box office and try there first. This company is disgusting.

reviews.title: No payout
reviews.text: I sold tickets on Gametime, never received a payout. No answer to my messages.

reviews.title: DO NOT USE
reviews.text: I have always had a bad experience with game time, and the only reason I kept going back was because the prices are normally cheaper. Last week, I purchased a ticket for Malcolm Todd on September 14. I was told I would receive a ticket by September 22, one day before the concert. On September 23, I realized I didn’t have the ticket so I reached out to ask for it. What they ended up sending me was a FRAUDULENT ticket. They sent me a link to a PDF and nothing that could transfer into my account. I told them that I have never had an experience with a ticket just being sent as a PDF and not something that can be transferred into my Ticketmaster account. Which I told them, and asked for a different ticket that was real and I could send their PDF back so I could have peace of mind. One I knew that the ticket is real and they refused. When I got to the venue and tried to scan the ticket it was unable to scan which I sent proof of to them. They tried to get me a different ticket which I got an email to accept it ,and following an email right away saying that that seat wasn’t available, and for me to choose a different seat or give me a refund. I was on the phone with Gametime for an hour and missed the concert. they said the ticket was transferred to me and accepted, but I never received it. I sent proof that I’ve never had it and they told me to go to box office which I did and there was no ticket for that email. They sent it to a different email not the one that I purchased through

reviews.title: $346 WASTED
reviews.text: Purchased a pair of tickets to a music festival through gametime for $346. After waiting in line to enter the venue, the tickets did NOT work. After speaking to a customer service representative, I was repeatedly told I would need to fill out a resolution form for the investigation team to review. I respectfully told them I’d gladly answer any questions that they had on the form directly over the phone. I’ve worked in customer service for several years, and would not take “this is just our policy” for an answer. After some insistence, I was escalated to a supervisor (Gino.) I explained to Gino that I would again not accept “fill out the form and wait for the resolution team to come up with a solution” for an answer. I AM OUT OF $346. Gino then transferred me to a “manager”? (Charlie.) Soon after once again explaining my situation to Charlie, about waiting in line at the venue and then getting publicly embarrassed when the tickets didn’t work, I was told fill out the form or you’re out of luck. He then proceeded to abruptly hang up the phone. This was now after being on hold and getting the run around for several hours so business hours were now closed and could no longer get a hold of anyone. DON’T DO BUSINESS WITH THIS MORALLY BANKRUPT COMPANY.

reviews.title: Don’t be swayed by their pretty pictures
reviews.text:
The second star is for the purchase process. It’s easy and the ticket transfer is seamless. However the view from your seat function is a bit of a joke. You’re getting a view from the area your seat is in, not from your specific seats. I purchased tickets for a baseball game last weekend. They were in the first row and our view from the seats was obscured to an extent by the rain tarp. One in my party had to sit on a backpack just to see over the tarp. The view in the app for those seats actually is from about 10 rows up from the field. 

I reached out to Gametime and asked if I could review the seats or post a photo, just so others would know about that potential obstruction. Not only did they tell me that the venue didn’t consider the seats obstructed, they also told me there was no place to post those photos, even though I see other user photos from that section. I wasn’t looking for anything other than an opportunity to share my in-venue experience with others. Be aware that what you’re seeing isn’t exactly what you’re getting.

reviews.title: Buyer Beware
reviews.text: The game and the seats were terrific.  The buying experience through Gametime was horrible.  I had a previous good experience purchasing Rose Bowl tickets, so I was stunned and disappointed with the experience this time.  I feel ripped off by Gametime.  I attempted to purchase two tickets to the Royals/Dodgers game on 8/11.  I went through the process, selected my seats and when I tried to pay, I got an error message and was given a phone number to call.  Instead of calling the number, I select two other seats and purchased those successfully.  When I went to download my tickets onto the MLB app, I was surprised to see that I was now the owner for 4 seats.  I contacted Gametime immediately and went back and forth on the chat function first with a bot, then a real person.  Gametime refused to take responsibility and refund me for two of the tickets despite repeated requests and evidence of their error.  Their only advice was to try to resell two of my tickets, which I tried to do but failed.   I am very disappointed with Gametime's app and their unwillingness to take responsibility for their error.  I DO NOT recommend them for purchasing tickets and I certainly will switch to another platform.

reviews.title: Never Received Tickets & Awful Customer Service
reviews.text: I was supposed to go to a concert yesterday 03/13, but couldn’t because I never got my tickets. The second I bought them back in October I was confused on the fact that it showed that they’ll be mailed to my address, but didn’t think much on that. I kept waiting to see if I ever got an update on the shipping. IT WASNT UNTIL YESTERDAY THE DAY OF THE CONCERT THAT I FINALLY CALL THEM TO ASK ABOUT THE TICKETS ONLY FOR THEM TO FINALLY GIVE ME THE TRACKING NUMBER WHICH WAS USELESS AT THIS POINT BECAUSE THEY WERE APPARENTLY DELIVERED LAST YEAR NOVEMBER 3RD 2025. HOW WAS I SUPPOSED TO KNOW THAT????. I called customer service for them to be useless and tell me to call FedEx. I call FedEx and which tell me what the, now useless, tracking information says, that they were delivered, but they’d look into it. I call back your customer service to be told that it was FedEx fault and that they had nothing to do with me not receiving them. NEVER HAVE I ORDERED SOMETHING AND NOT RECEIVED A TRACKING NUMBER OR ANY COMMUNICATION OF WHEN THEYD ARRIVE. How was I supposed to guess within the 5 month time frame WHEN ID RECEIVE MY TICKETS. It’s not up to FedEx to provide me the tracking information ITS UP TO GAMETIME!!!!! Made worse by the rude and what felt like useless customer service reps. THEY REFUSED TO PROVIDE ME E TICKETS OR ANY OTHER WAY TO MAKE THIS RIGHT. NOT EVEN A REFUND AT THAT POINT.

reviews.title: Buyer BEWARE
reviews.text:
First I want to say I was a regular customer of Gametime for almost a decade. In October 2025, I bought tickets to an away game and after arriving, I realize my tickets were never going to be delivered. I was not super worried because Gametime offers a “ gametime guarantee” which says you will receive tickets that are equal or better. I want to let you know that their definition of equal or better is not like anyone else’s  on this planet.  Long story short, I ended up in nosebleed seats after purchasing tickets that were eight rows back. I complained multiple times and was given a $50 credit to use for a future event. I am posting this now because I have tried to use this credit twice and the transaction will not go through. Both times I have been directed by customer service to use a different platform to buy tickets to said event. 

Long story, short, they are guarantee is not legit. They did not fulfill their promise of providing tickets that are equal. And then when giving me a credit, it’s actually unusable so they did absolutely nothing to make this right.  Terrible customer service and I could not recommend someone ever use this app with the risk of this happening to them.

reviews.title: Terrible first time experience
reviews.text: This was my first time buying  tickets on Gametime.  I was told by Gametime that the venue required that the tickets be printed. I explained to Gametime that I was traveling to New York City and could they please send the tickets before I left on Sunday so I could print them. The play started at 7:30 PM. I left the hotel late at 7 PM because I was at the Front Desk trying to print the tickets.  We got to the venue and they couldn’t find our tickets either , Gametime finally sent the tickets at 7:20 PM. The Broadway play started at 7:30 PM! No communication from Gametime explaining that the tickets were going to be issued 10 minutes before the play started. Honestly, not the way I want to be treated and not the way I should’ve been treated. I paid Gametime for the tickets a week prior.  I would not recommend putting yourself through the experience because you’ve taken the time to travel, plane ride, hotel, etc. you’re at the venue and you have no idea if you’re going to receive the tickets . well that’s going through your mind is I’ve been ripped off. They market the Gametime guaranteed but it’s not a guarantee that you will receive tickets it’s a guarantee for a refund. We made the effort in the expense for the experience, definitely not to receive a refund. Thanks but no thanks. Terrible experience, bad enough that I took the time to write this review. I won’t use them ever again.
